pet_trainer.description: Craft items to train and enhance your pets.

job_description.description: A skilled handler who trains and enhances the town's animal companions.
job_description.requirements: Requires a level 2 Trapper or level 2 Shepherd.

level_data.l1_description: The Pet Trainer can tame animals much more reliably than the Trapper at the Trapping Grounds.
level_data.l1_training_description: The Pet Trainer can train combat capable Pets, giving small them small boosts for combat.
level_data.l2_description: Unlocks more advanced pet training providing a larger effect.
level_data.l3_description: The Pet Trainer provides a much more powerful and longer lasting effect.

outfit.name: Pet Trainer's Outfit
outfit.description: The outfit of a skilled pet trainer.

talisman.name: Training Whistle
talisman.description: A talisman used to promote a hearthling to Pet Trainer.

personality.beleaguered_leader: As if I did not have enough to do...
personality.hopeless_optimist: I cannot wait to work with the animals!
personality.lovable_rogue: Animals are way more fun than people.
personality.psychopathic_misanthrope: Finally, companions that do not talk back.
personality.insufferable_academic: The behavioral patterns of domesticated animals are fascinating.
personality.diligent_sweetheart: I will take such good care of them!

pet_trainer_talisman.flavor: A talisman that channels the bond between trainer and beast. (Placeholder model)

deer_horned.description: A fierce horned deer trained as a combat companion.

passionate_pet_trainer.description: This hearthling has a natural affinity for animals and finds great joy in training them. They will be happier and more effective as a Pet Trainer.
